summary: Treat the API as authoritative for eval history and hydrate per-case results.
reason: The eval-run list endpoint that sync mirrors carries aggregate counts only; per-case verdicts exist solely on the detail endpoint, so the command reported zero cases against a fully synced mirror. Sync also collapses .../eval/set and .../eval/run onto one resource name and silently drops records.
validated_outcome: Against a live project holding two eval runs the mirror held one; the command now reports both and says so in its note.
